content: Anḍeř n Yasuɛ ixwa
Deg wass amezwaru n ssimana tusa-dd Maryam n Majdala di ṣṣbeḥ zic ɣar wenḍeř, tuɣa ɛad d taǧest. Teẓra taṣḍart aqa temmeksi x wenḍeř.
Tuzzeř-dd, tusa-dd ɣar Cimɛun Buṭrus u ɣar umeḥḍar nneɣni wenni umi tuɣa ittexs Yasuɛ, tenna asen: “Ksin Siditneɣ zeg wenḍeř, war ssineɣ mani t ggin.”
Iffeɣ-dd Cimɛun d umeḥḍar nneɣni uca usin-dd ɣar wenḍeř.
Nitni uzzřen s tnayen idsen, maca ameḥḍar nneɣni izwar i Cimɛun uca yiweḍ d amezwaru ɣar wenḍeř.
Ixzar, iẓra řecfun n řeqṭen azdad mmarsen din, maca war yudif ca.
Iḍfar i-t Cimɛun, yudef ɣar wenḍeř, iẓra ɛawed řecfun n řeqṭen azdad mmarsen din.
Amendiř nni tuɣa x uzeǧif nnes, war immars ca ak-d řecfun n řeqṭen azdad, maca tuɣa iḍfeṣ, ittwagg deg wemcan weḥḥdes.
Řexdenni yudef-dd uřa d ameḥḍar nneɣni nni dd-yusin d amezwaru ɣar wenḍeř, iẓra uca yumen.
Minzi nitni tuɣa ɛad war ssinen Tira Iqeddsen, belli ittxeṣṣa as ad ikkar jar imettinen.
Xenni dewřen imeḥḍaren nni ɣar taddart nsen.
Aḍhar n Yasuɛ i Maryam zi Majdala
Maryam teqqim tbedd ɣar wenḍeř barra, tᵉttru. Řami tuɣa tᵉttru, tesweḍ deg wenḍeř,
teẓra tnayen n lmalakat s warruḍ d acemřař, qqiment mani tuɣa temmars arrimet n Yasuɛ, ijjen ɣar tsummtin nnes n uzeǧif, ijjen ɣar iḍaren nnes.
Nnan as: “A tamɣart, mayemmi tᵉttrud?” Tenna asen: “Maɣar kksen Sidi inu, war ssineɣ mani t ssarsen.”
Umi tenna aya, tenneqřeb ɣar ḍeffar, teẓra Yasuɛ ibedd, maca war tessin ca aqa-t d Yasuɛ.
Yasuɛ inna as: “A tamɣart, mayemmi tᵉttrud? Min xef tarezzud?” Tᵉttɣiř as Netta d bab n teḥwict, tenna as: “A sidi mařa cek i-t iksin, ini ayi mani t tessarsed, xenni ad t ksiɣ.”
Yasuɛ inna as: “A Maryam!” Nettat tenneqřeb, tenna as s Tɛibranit: “A Rabbuli!”, ixs ad yini: ‘A Amseɣɣar inu’.
Yasuɛ inna as: “War d ayi tᵉttḥidi ca, aqa Necc ɛad war geɛɛdeɣ ca ɣar Baba, maca ruḥ ɣar aytma, ini asen: ‘Necc aqa ad geɛɛdeɣ ɣar Baba d Babatwem, ɣar AREBBI inu d AREBBI nwem.’”
Teɛqeb-dd Maryam n Majdala txebbar imeḥḍaren belli nettat teẓra Siditneɣ u belli Netta inna as man aya.
Aḍhar n Yasuɛ i imeḥḍaren nnes
Ɣar tmeddit n wass nni, netta d ass amezwaru n ssimana, umi tuɣa tiwwura mani tuɣa qqimen imeḥḍaren qqnent s tiggʷudi zeg Wudayen, yudef-dd Yasuɛ, ibedd di řwesṭ nsen, inna asen: “Sřam xawem.”
Awarni řami inna aya, immeř asen ifassen nnes d uɣezdis nnes. Farḥen imeḥḍaren řami ẓrin Siditneɣ.
Inna asen ɛawed Yasuɛ: “Sřam xawem, am mammec d ayi dd-issekk Baba, ad kenniw dd-ssekkeɣ uřa d Necc.”
Awarni řami inna man aya, isuḍ daysen, inna asen: “Qebřem Arruḥ Iqeddsen.”
Wenni umi ɣa teɣfarem ddnub nnes, ad as ttwaɣfaren ddnub nnes. Wenni umi d as i ɣa tᵉṭṭfem di ddnub nnes, ad as ttwaṭṭfen ddnub nnes.”
Yasuɛ isscen ixef nnes i Tuma
Maca Tuma, ijjen zi tenɛac, wenni umi qqaren ‘Acniw’, war tuɣi ca akidsen řami dd-yusa Yasuɛ.

Nnan as imeḥḍaren: “Aqa neẓra Siditneɣ!” Maca netta inna asen: “Mařa war ẓriɣ řimařt n imesmiren deg ifassen nnes, ad ssarseɣ aḍaḍ inu deg wemcan n imesmiren uca ad ssarseɣ afus inu deg uɣezdis nnes, war ttimneɣ.”
Awarni tmenya n wussan tuɣa imeḥḍaren nnes ɛawed ɣar daxeř u Tuma tuɣa akidsen. Yudef-dd Yasuɛ, waxxa tiwwura tuɣa qqnent, uca ibedd-dd di řwesṭ nsen, inna: “Sřam xawem!”
Inna i Tuma: “Awi-dd aḍaḍ nnec uca xzar deg ifassen inu, sars afus nnec danita u sidef i-t deg uɣezdis inu. War ttiři d akafriw, maca d řmumen.”
Yarra-dd Tuma, inna as: “A Sidi inu d AREBBI inu!”
Inna as Yasuɛ: “Umi teẓrid ayi řexxu, aqa tumned, a Tuma! Sseɛd n yinni yumnen, waxxa nitni war d ayi ẓrin.”
Yasuɛ igga aṭṭas n řeɛřamat nneɣni qibač i imeḥḍaren nnes, tinni war yurint ca deg wedlis-a,
maca tina urant ḥima ad tamnem belli Yasuɛ Netta d Lmasiḥ, Mmis n AREBBI, uca xmi ɣa tamnem, ad ɣarwem tiři Tudart s Yisem nnes.
